session_history.observation: Native SOLIDWORKS 2026 SP0 opened. Two finger STEP files and a macro were uploaded.
First macro encountered missing SOLIDWORKS type-library references, then an invalid assignment from a void setter. No native geometry output was verified.
First cloud session timed out before a verified native geometry checkpoint.
Vendor-offered Launch used the same account. Same user-approved software license accepted. 28 link STEP files, AutoFingerImportV2.swb and AutoFullArmStaticV1.swb uploaded to remote Temporary Files.
Native application is open with corrected V2 source being edited. V2 and full-static V1 have local source audits only; neither has a verified native compile or run.
User-approved software license accepted; native SOLIDWORKS Design Premium 2026 SP0 available.
Full-static V1 compiled natively, then stopped at preference readback.
V2 imported base_link. Save returned True, errors 0, warnings 0; an incorrect Boolean check falsely reported save failure. This is API evidence in the cloud, not a locally recovered file.

V3 corrected Boolean checks and reached the first-component assembly stage after its 28-part import/save loop. Screenshots directly show index_intermediate and thumb_proximal with 12 solid bodies. Assembly stopped with runtime error 438 at Transform2 assignment; all-28 completion is control-flow inference, not individually recovered evidence.
V4 replaces Set comp.Transform2 = transform with the officially verified plain property assignment comp.Transform2 = transform. Native V4 compile/run not verified.
Third session expired before native CAD was downloaded. Temporary Files are deleted under the published trial policy. No recoverable local native CAD artifact exists.
Plan full-static V5 automatic single-ZIP packaging for prompt download. User approved a temporary browser download followed by move to D:. No fourth-session execution or download is claimed here.
V5 completed the native 28-part/293-solid import, placement, rebuild and save gates. Full all-fixed arm and SLDASM visible. No mates, articulated movement or engineering study are implied.
V5 stopped after saving geometry because ZIP packaging/validation failed; dialog noted code 124 denotes the bounded job wait expiring. Geometry remained in cloud at that point.
After manual Window > Close All, ArchiveNativeResultsV1 succeeded and verified a remote archive of 28 parts, one assembly and original build log. Approximately 10 MB.
Browser download waitForEvent/click timed out; no completed local download confirmed before the fourth trial ended. No D: native CAD checkpoint is recovered.
V6 is being prepared to close saved project documents before robust allowlisted ZIP packaging. Native V6 execution has not been verified.
V6 completed 28 native parts/293 solids, static assembly save, automatic close and verified 30-file ZIP. Native message explicitly labels all-fixed/static, no mates/Motion/FEA.
Independent README click test produced no confirmed local file; downloadMedia failed and download-event wait timed out. Archive remains a remote artifact at snapshot.
User asked to manually download the displayed archive before reported 19:36 local expiry. No reply or completed local download is recorded.

Reached DIP_DRIVEN_10DEG.SLDASM with parent fixed, child floating and Mates created, then error -2147220784: Actual signed flexion differs from target by over 0.5 degrees. Full sweep/limit conversion/ZIP not completed or confirmed; no local native files.

At approximately 19:36 Asia/Shanghai, browser tab 17 redirected to MySolidWorks feedback. Native archive was not transferred; D:/RoboticArm/solidworks/native_results is empty. No retained cloud recovery is claimed.
